avasthas.description: Planetary states (Avasthas) describe how a planet feels and behaves based on its position in the chart. They determine the quality and timing of results.

baladi_avasthas.description: Age-based states. Determined by the planet's degree in its sign. Odd signs: divide 30 degrees into 5 equal parts (6 degrees each) in order. Even signs: reverse order.

states.name: Bala
states.effect: Immature results, delayed but eventually manifests. Like a child, the planet gives incomplete and delayed results.

states.name: Kumara
states.effect: Growing strength, partial results. Like a teenager, ambitious but not yet fully capable.
characteristics: Energy present but not fully directed

states.name: Yuva
states.effect: Full strength, complete results. Planet at peak performance, delivers maximum potential.

states.name: Vriddha
states.effect: Declining, delayed results. Wisdom but diminishing capacity to act.

states.name: Mrita
states.effect: No results, planet effectively inactive. Like a dead person, the planet cannot deliver its significations.
characteristics: Requires strong benefic aspect for any results

baladi_avasthas.calculation_rule: For odd signs (Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius): Bala(0-6), Kumara(6-12), Yuva(12-18), Vriddha(18-24), Mrita(24-30). For even signs (Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Capricorn, Pisces): Mrita(0-6), Vriddha(6-12), Yuva(12-18), Kumara(18-24), Bala(24-30).

shayanaadi_avasthas.description: Activity-based states based on complex positional calculations. Derived from Parashara's BPHS. Shows what the planet is 'doing' at the moment.

states.name: Shayana
states.effect: Planet is dormant, lazy, not giving results actively

states.name: Upavesha
states.effect: Planet is seated, passive but aware, minimal effort

states.name: Netrapani
states.effect: Planet cannot see, is confused or misguided

states.name: Prakasha
states.effect: Planet is bright and powerful, giving excellent results

states.name: Gamana
states.effect: Planet is actively moving toward its goals, good results

states.name: Aagama
states.effect: Planet is returning, revisiting past themes, moderate results

states.name: Sabha
states.effect: Planet is in a position of social influence, good for public matters

states.name: Agama
states.effect: Planet is approaching its destination, building results

states.name: Bhojana
states.effect: Planet is nourished and satisfied, comfortable results

states.name: Nritya
states.effect: Planet is joyful and expressive, creative and artistic results

states.name: Kautuka
states.effect: Planet is curious and exploring, learning and discovery

states.name: Nidraa
states.effect: Planet is in deep sleep, completely inactive

shayanaadi_avasthas.calculation_rule: Complex calculation involving the planet's nakshatra position, sign, and specific divisional computations as described in BPHS chapters on avasthas.

jagradaadi_avasthas.description: Consciousness-based states: Jagrat (waking), Swapna (dreaming), Sushupti (deep sleep). Based on planet's position in own/friendly/enemy signs.

states.name: Jagrat
states.condition: Planet in own sign or exaltation
states.effect: Planet fully awake and giving complete results

states.name: Swapna
states.condition: Planet in friendly sign or neutral sign
states.effect: Planet partially aware, moderate results

states.name: Sushupti
states.condition: Planet in enemy sign or debilitation
states.effect: Planet completely unaware, minimal or no results

deeptaadi_avasthas.description: Brightness-based states derived from a planet's relationship with its sign lord and position. Nine states from Deepta (blazing) to Kshudita (hungry).

states.name: Deepta
states.effect: Planet gives extraordinary results, fame, success, and glory

states.name: Swastha
states.effect: Planet is happy and gives good, natural results

states.name: Mudita
states.effect: Planet is pleased and gives favorable results

states.name: Shanta
states.condition: Planet in auspicious shashtiamsha or varga
states.effect: Planet gives peaceful, gentle, favorable results

states.name: Dina
states.effect: Planet gives mediocre, average results

states.name: Dukhita
states.effect: Planet suffers and gives troublesome results

states.name: Vikala
states.effect: Planet loses power, significations harmed

states.name: Khala
states.effect: Planet gives adverse, harmful results

states.name: Bhita
states.condition: Planet defeated in planetary war (Graha Yuddha)
states.effect: Planet is afraid and fails to deliver results
